Stagiaire en génie logiciel et IA / AI Software Engineering Intern


Français


MOSU est une jeune entreprise technologique montréalaise qui développe des outils pour rendre les commandes de vêtements sur mesure à distance plus fiables. Nous cherchons une personne stagiaire rémunérée, à temps plein, pour contribuer directement au développement du produit avec le fondateur.


Le travail portera d’abord sur un parcours de prise de mesures à distance : saisie structurée, vérification des données, suivi des versions, révision par les designers et transmission de spécifications approuvées à la production. Vous développerez et testerez des prototypes logiciels et explorerez des usages ciblés de l’IA, par exemple pour signaler des mesures manquantes ou incohérentes. Les résultats devront être évalués; MOSU ne présume pas qu’un modèle puisse garantir l’ajustement d’un vêtement.


Nous recherchons une personne à l’aise avec Python ou JavaScript/TypeScript, les API, Git et les tests logiciels, qui aime résoudre des problèmes concrets et documenter ses choix. Une expérience en apprentissage automatique, en évaluation de modèles ou en protection des données est un atout.


Conditions : 40 heures par semaine; salaire brut de 4 000 $ CA par mois. MOSU est exploitée par GOLLAPALLY ADVENTURES INC., à Montréal.


English


MOSU is an early-stage Montréal technology startup developing tools to make remote custom-fashion orders more reliable. We are seeking a paid, full-time engineering intern to work directly with the founder on product development.


The initial work centres on a remote measurement workflow: structured capture, data checks, version history, designer review and handoff of approved garment specifications to production. You will build and test software prototypes and explore focused uses of AI, such as flagging missing or inconsistent measurements. You will evaluate results rather than assume an AI model can guarantee garment fit.


We’re looking for someone comfortable with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, Git and software testing, with an interest in solving practical problems and documenting decisions. Experience with machine learning, model evaluation or data privacy is an asset.


Terms: 40 hours per week; CA$4,000 gross per month. MOSU is operated by GOLLAPALLY ADVENTURES INC. in Montréal.
fit_why: Web/API stack with Python/JS, AI integration; fits well

Your Role 

 As a Software Engineering Intern , you will join a software development team supporting the certification of software used in aerospace and defense applications. You will gain hands-on experience working with production software while learning the rigorous development and certification practices required by the DO-178C standard. 

 You will contribute to smaller development and certification activities, working alongside experienced engineers on requirements, design, code updates, reviews, and bug fixes. 

 Your Responsibilities 

• Support software development and certification activities in accordance with DO-178C processes. 
• Contribute to requirements, software design, code updates, and technical reviews . 
• Work on smaller pull requests and bug fixes with guidance from experienced team members. 
• Help maintain traceability between requirements, design, and source code as part of the certification process. 
• Participate in independent reviews of engineering work and documentation. 
• Collaborate with team members throughout the software development and certification lifecycle. 
• Learn and apply structured development practices required for safety-critical software. 
• Demonstrate curiosity, willingness to learn, and active engagement with the engineering team. 
 Your Background 

• Currently pursuing a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering , or a related technical field. 
• Academic, project, or professional experience with C or C++ . 
• Previous internship or relevant practical experience is preferred . 
• Interest in software development, software quality, and structured engineering processes. 
• Ability and willingness to learn technical concepts and work within a rigorous development environment. 
• Availability to work on-site in the Ottawa area three days per week .
